description: Dismiss ALL pending out-of-scope edits for a feature so the gated Pass is no longer soft-blocked by them. Clears the MCP scope-watcher pending store for that slug AND marks the extension edit-history entries skipped (extension dismissPendingScopeEdits parity). Use after the owner decides the out-of-scope writes are acceptable but does not want to Keep/Revert each one.

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.

name: cpfs_dismiss_pending_scope_edits
